title: City traffic
description: An aerial view of a rendered city at dusk, with high-rise towers on the horizon and dense blocks below. A large highway interchange with elevated ramps crosses the foreground. Hundreds of small green and blue lights mark vehicles moving along the highways and city streets. The camera drifts slowly over the city.
credit: Proposal defense presentation, slide 14. Animated GIF converted to silent MP4 and scaled to 1600 pixels wide.
